_comment: Audium (Lavalink v4 node) — Pterodactyl egg. See pterodactyl/README.md.
name: Audium
author: CodeX Development
description: Audium — a native Rust Lavalink v4 audio node (no JVM, integrated sources). Runs from source via cargo on first boot; see the README for the faster prebuilt-binary path.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Audium installer — runs once inside the egg's container.
# During install the server volume is mounted at /mnt/server; at runtime it is
# /home/container. We install everything under the volume so it persists.
set -e

apt update
apt install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl git ca-certificates build-essential cmake pkg-config \
    libclang-dev clang perl libopus-dev

# opus is linked statically so the resulting binary has no runtime opus dep.
export LIBOPUS_STATIC=1
export OPUS_STATIC=1

# Rust toolchain into the server volume so it persists across restarts.
export CARGO_HOME=/mnt/server/.cargo
export RUSTUP_HOME=/mnt/server/.rustup
export PATH="${CARGO_HOME}/bin:${PATH}"
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable --no-modify-path

cd /mnt/server
git clone https://github.com/Nikhil309-dev/Kizunalink.git repo
cd repo
git checkout main

# Minimal config.toml; the panel's AUDIUM_* variables override it at runtime.
cat > /mnt/server/config.toml <<'EOF'
[server]
address = "0.0.0.0"
port = 2333
authorization = "replace-with-your-strong-secret"

[logging]
level = "info"

[logging.file]
path = "/home/container/logs/audium.log"
max_lines = 10000
max_files = 7
EOF

mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs

# Pre-build so the first start is fast; failures here are non-fatal.
cargo build --release --locked || echo "[installer] prebuild failed; will build on start"

echo "Audium install complete."

variables.name: Authorization Secret
variables.description: Required. Strong random secret clients use as the Lavalink password. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: Bind Address
variables.description: Interface to listen on. Keep 0.0.0.0 so the panel can route the allocation to the process.

variables.name: Port
variables.description: Port to listen on. Must equal the primary allocation port the panel shows for this server.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: trace | debug | info | warn | error | off

variables.name: Rate Limit (per minute)
variables.description: Max REST + WS requests per client IP per minute. 0 disables.

variables.name: Prometheus Metrics
variables.description: Enable the authenticated Prometheus metrics endpoint.
